Babbitt by Sinclair Lewis — Canadian McLeod Hardcover

A navy-blue clothbound copy of Sinclair Lewis’s novel, with orange cover and spine lettering. The title page bears the Toronto imprint of George J. McLeod, Limited.

Condition

Used cloth hardcover with cover spotting/staining, including an irregular front-cover stain, back-cover scuffs/scratches, spine fading and rubbing, frayed spine ends, bumped corners/edges and age-toned pages. No dust jacket. Printing/state unconfirmed. Please review all photographs; the book has not been inspected page by page.

Details

  • Title: Babbitt. Author: Sinclair Lewis. English-language hardcover.
  • Title-page publisher: George J. McLeod, Limited, Toronto.
  • Copyright page dated 1922, Harcourt, Brace and Company, Inc.; printed in the U.S.A. by Quinn & Boden Company, Rahway, New Jersey.
  • Printing/state and exact printing date have not been confirmed; no first-edition or first-printing claim is made.
  • Approximately 5¼ × 7½ × 1½ inches; book weighs approximately 1 lb 0.5 oz.

Included

One clothbound hardcover book, exactly as photographed. No dust jacket.

Packing & Shipping

Covers, corners and edges will be protected, and the book packed securely in a rigid box. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
